description: This file is the main activity class for an Android application that demonstrates media routing and presentation on secondary displays using the MediaRouter API. It manages the detection of external displays, handles route selection and disconnection, and controls a secondary presentation to show content on the secondary display. Key functionalities include setup of media router callbacks, presentation management, and UI interaction to change background colors on the secondary display.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating media routing and secondary display presentation in an Android app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, resources, and media router.

methods.name: updatePresentation
methods.description: Updates the secondary presentation based on current media routing state.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers media router callback and updates display status.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Dismisses the presentation when activity is stopped.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu with media route actions.

methods.name: showNextColor
methods.description: Cycles to the next color and updates the secondary presentation.
